passages.text: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
passages.sermon:
All the people of Israel gathered together.
They came to David.
They met him at Hebron.
They spoke to David.
They said, “We are your own flesh and blood.”
passages.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֧וּ כָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָה לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֛ה עַצְמְךָ֥ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’ ”
passages.sermon:
David was a leader of Israel.
Saul was king in the past.
Even then, David led Israel out to battle.
David also brought Israel back safely.
The LORD is David’s God.
The LORD spoke to David.
The LORD said, “You will shepherd My people Israel.”
The LORD said, “You will be ruler over My people Israel.”
passages.original: גַּם־ תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם־ שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם בִּהְי֣וֹת שָׁא֣וּל מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא וְהַמֵּבִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD through Samuel.
passages.sermon:
All the elders of Israel came to David.
David was at Hebron.
David was the king.
The elders met David at Hebron.
David made a covenant with the elders.
They made this covenant before the LORD.
The elders anointed David.
They anointed David to be king over Israel.
This happened as the LORD had spoken.
The LORD spoke this word through Samuel.
passages.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
passages.sermon:
David was the leader of Israel.
All the Israelites followed David.
David and all the Israelites marched together.
They went to Jerusalem.
Jerusalem was also called Jebus.
The Jebusites lived in that land.
The Jebusites were the people who inhabited Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֧יד וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס וְשָׁם֙ הַיְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
The people of Jebus lived in Jerusalem.
The people of Jebus spoke to David.
They said, “You will never get in here.”
David captured the fortress of Zion.
The fortress of Zion is the City of David.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ לְדָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃

passages.text: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to his men.
David said, “Whoever strikes down a Jebusite first will become chief and leader.”
Joab was the son of Zeruiah.
Joab went up first.
Joab struck down a Jebusite first.
Joab became the chief.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד כָּל־ מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ בָּרִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְרֹ֖אשׁ וּלְשָׂ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַל בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י לְרֹֽאשׁ׃

passages.text: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David captured the fortress of Zion.
David lived in the fortress.
People called the fortress the City of David.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב דָּוִ֖יד בַּמְצָ֑ד עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ־ ל֖וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃

passages.text: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David built up the city.
He built around the fortress.
He built from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall.
Joab was the chief commander.
Joab restored the rest of the city.
passages.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן הָעִיר֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב מִן־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וְעַד־ הַסָּבִ֑יב וְיוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת־ שְׁאָ֥ר הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David became more powerful.
The LORD of Hosts was with David.
God made David great.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖יד הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
He had mighty men.
These men were chiefs among his warriors.
They stood with David in his kingdom.
All Israel supported David as king.
These chiefs and all Israel made his kingdom strong.
They did this because the LORD spoke about Israel.
The LORD’s word guided them.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י הַגִּבּוֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֔יד הַמִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים עִמּ֧וֹ בְמַלְכוּת֛וֹ עִם־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִיכ֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: This is the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David had mighty men who served him.
This is the list of David’s mighty men.
Jashobeam was one of these men.
Jashobeam was the son of Hachmoni.
Jashobeam was chief of the officers.
Jashobeam fought against three hundred men at one time.
Jashobeam used his spear in this battle.
Jashobeam killed all three hundred men in that one battle.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑יד יָשָׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁים הֽוּא־ עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֛וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם אֶחָֽת׃

passages.text: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was the son of Dodo.
Eleazar was an Ahohite.
Eleazar was next in command after Jashobeam.
Eleazar was one of the three mighty men of David.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ הָאֲחוֹחִ֑י ה֖וּא בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃

passages.text: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At the place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was with David at Pas-dammim.
The Philistines gathered there for battle.
There was a field full of barley at that place.
The Israelite troops fled from the Philistines.
passages.original: הֽוּא־ הָיָ֨ה עִם־ דָּוִ֜יד בַּפַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים וְהַפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֱסְפוּ־ שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was a mighty warrior.
David was the king of Israel.
Eleazar and David stood together in the middle of the field.
They defended the field.
They fought against the Philistines.
They struck down the Philistines.
The LORD gave a great victory.
passages.original: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְתוֹךְ־ הַחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּיל֔וּהָ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיּ֥וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David, to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.sermon:
Three men were leaders among David’s thirty mighty warriors.
These three men went down to David.
David was at the rock near the cave of Adullam.
At that time, the Philistines had set up camp.
The Philistine camp was in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.original: וַיֵּרְד֡וּ שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ עַל־ הַצֻּר֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔יד אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃

passages.text: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
passages.sermon: David was in the stronghold at that time.\r\nThe Philistines had a garrison at Bethlehem.
passages.original: וְדָוִ֖יד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּנְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
passages.sermon:
David was in the stronghold.
David was surrounded by enemies.
David felt great longing.
David wanted water.
David spoke.
David said, “Who will give me water to drink?”
David wanted water from a special place.
David wanted water from the well.
The well was near the gate of Bethlehem.
passages.original: וַיִּתְאָו דָּוִ֖יד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבּ֥וֹר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃

passages.text: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD, saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
passages.sermon:
Three mighty men served David.
At that time, David was in a stronghold.
The Philistines had a garrison at Bethlehem.
David longed for water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem.
The three men broke through the Philistine camp.
They drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem.
They carried the water back to David.
David refused to drink the water.
He poured the water out to the LORD.
David said, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this!”
He said, “How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?”
They brought the water at the risk of their lives.
David would not drink it.
These were the exploits of the three mighty men.
passages.original: וַיִּבְקְע֨וּ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֜ה בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֙יִם֙ מִבּ֤וֹר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֑יד וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיְנַסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃ וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָה֩ לִּ֨י מֵאֱלֹהַ֜י מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת זֹ֗את הֲדַ֣ם הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ הָאֵ֨לֶּה אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה בְנַפְשׁוֹתָם֙ כִּ֣י בְנַפְשׁוֹתָ֣ם הֱבִיא֔וּם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃

passages.text: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
passages.sermon:
Abishai was the brother of Joab.
Abishai was chief of the Three mighty men.
Abishai lifted his spear against three hundred men.
Abishai killed those three hundred men.
Abishai won a name along with the Three mighty men.
Abishai was not one of the original Three.
passages.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י אֲחִֽי־ יוֹאָ֗ב ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְלֹא שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלוֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
passages.sermon:
Abishai was the brother of Joab.
Abishai was chief of the Three mighty men.
Abishai received greater honor than the Three.
Abishai became their commander.
Abishai was not counted among the Three.
passages.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה בַשְּׁנַ֙יִם֙ נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹֽא־ בָֽא׃ס

passages.text: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Jehoiada was a man of valor.
Benaiah came from Kabzeel.
Benaiah was known for many exploits.
Benaiah struck down two champions from Moab.
One day, snow covered the ground.
Benaiah went down into a pit that day.
He killed a lion inside the pit.
passages.original: בְּנָיָ֨ה בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־ אִֽישׁ־ חַ֛יִל רַב־ פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽן־ קַבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִיאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־ הָאֲרִ֛י בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבּ֖וֹר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃

passages.text: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was a man of valor from Kabzeel.
He performed many great deeds.
Benaiah killed an Egyptian.
The Egyptian was a very tall man.
He stood five cubits high.
The Egyptian held a spear in his hand.
The spear was as thick as a weaver’s beam.
Benaiah approached the Egyptian with only a club.
Benaiah took the spear from the Egyptian’s hand.
Benaiah killed the Egyptian with the same spear.
passages.original: וְהֽוּא־ הִכָּה֩ אֶת־ הָאִ֨ישׁ הַמִּצְרִ֜י אִ֥ישׁ מִדָּ֣ה׀ חָמֵ֣שׁ בָּאַמָּ֗ה וּבְיַ֨ד הַמִּצְרִ֤י חֲנִית֙ כִּמְנ֣וֹר אֹרְגִ֔ים וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Benaiah did these great deeds.
Benaiah became famous.
Benaiah was honored with the three mighty men.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃

passages.text: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
passages.sermon:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a mighty warrior.
He was the most honored among the Thirty mighty men.
He did not become one of the Three greatest warriors.
David appointed Benaiah over his personal guard.
passages.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֗ים הִנּ֤וֹ נִכְבָּד֙ ה֔וּא וְאֶל־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־ בָ֑א וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖יד עַל־ מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Now these were the mighty men: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem, Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite, Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur, Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite, Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai, Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri, Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah, Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai, Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him, Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite, Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite, Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite, Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite, Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
passages.sermon:
These are the mighty men who served with David.
Asahel was the brother of Joab.
Elhanan was the son of Dodo from Bethlehem.
Shammoth was from Haror.
Helez was a Pelonite.
Ira was the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa.
Abiezer was from Anathoth.
Sibbecai was from Hushah.
Ilai was from Ahoah.
Maharai was from Netophah.
Heled was the son of Baanah from Netophah.
Ithai was the son of Ribai from Gibeah, a town of the Benjamites.
Benaiah was from Pirathon.
Hurai was from the brooks of Gaash.
Abiel was from the Arabah.
Azmaveth was from Baharum.
Eliahba was from Shaalbon.
The sons of Hashem were from Gizon.
Jonathan was the son of Shagee from Harar.
Ahiam was the son of Sachar from Harar.
Eliphal was the son of Ur.
Hepher was from Mecherah.
Ahijah was a Pelonite.
Hezro was from Carmel.
Naarai was the son of Ezbai.
Joel was the brother of Nathan.
Mibhar was the son of Hagri.
Zelek was an Ammonite.
Naharai was from Beeroth.
Naharai carried the weapons of Joab, the son of Zeruiah.
Ira was an Ithrite.
Gareb was an Ithrite.
Uriah was a Hittite.
Zabad was the son of Ahlai.
Adina was the son of Shiza, a Reubenite.
Adina was chief of the Reubenites.
Thirty men were with Adina.
Hanan was the son of Maacah.
Joshaphat was from Mithnah.
Uzzia was from Ashterath.
Shama and Jeiel were sons of Hotham from Aroer.
Jediael was the son of Shimri.
Joha was the brother of Jediael and was a Tizite.
Eliel was a Mahavite.
Jeribai and Joshaviah were sons of Elnaam.
Ithmah was a Moabite.
Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel were from Mezobah.
passages.original: וְגִבּוֹרֵ֖י הַחֲיָלִ֑ים עֲשָׂה־ אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ס שַׁמּוֹת֙ הַהֲרוֹרִ֔י חֶ֖לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִֽי׃ס עִירָ֤א בֶן־ עִקֵּשׁ֙ הַתְּקוֹעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר הָעֲנְּתוֹתִֽי׃ס סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י עִילַ֖י הָאֲחוֹחִֽי׃ס מַהְרַי֙ הַנְּטֹ֣פָתִ֔י חֵ֥לֶד בֶּֽן־ בַּֽעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטוֹפָתִֽי׃ס אִיתַ֣י בֶּן־ רִיבַ֗י מִגִּבְעַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ןס בְּנָיָ֖ה הַפִּרְעָתֹנִֽי׃ חוּרַי֙ מִנַּ֣חֲלֵי גָ֔עַשׁס אֲבִיאֵ֖ל הָעַרְבָתִֽי׃ס עַזְמָ֙וֶת֙ הַבַּ֣חֲרוּמִ֔י אֶלְיַחְבָּ֖א הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִֽי׃ס בְּנֵ֗י הָשֵׁם֙ הַגִּ֣זוֹנִ֔י יוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־ שָׁגֵ֖ה הַהֲרָרִֽי׃ס אֲחִיאָ֧ם בֶּן־ שָׂכָ֛ר הַהֲרָרִ֖י אֱלִיפַ֥ל בֶּן־ אֽוּר׃ס חֵ֚פֶר הַמְּכֵ֣רָתִ֔י אֲחִיָּ֖ה הַפְּלֹנִֽי׃ס חֶצְרוֹ֙ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י נַעֲרַ֖י בֶּן־ אֶזְבָּֽי׃ס יוֹאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י נָתָ֔ן מִבְחָ֖ר בֶּן־ הַגְרִֽי׃ס צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמּוֹנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַבֵּ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָֽה׃ס עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ס אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַחִתִּ֔י זָבָ֖ד בֶּן־ אַחְלָֽי׃ס עֲדִינָ֨א בֶן־ שִׁיזָ֜א הָרֽאוּבֵנִ֗י רֹ֛אשׁ לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְעָלָ֥יו שְׁלוֹשִֽׁים׃ס חָנָן֙ בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְיוֹשָׁפָ֖ט הַמִּתְנִֽי׃ס עֻזִיָּ֖א הָעֲשְׁתְּרָתִ֑י שָׁמָע֙ וִיעוּאֵל בְּנֵ֖י חוֹתָ֥ם הָעֲרֹעֵרִֽי׃ס יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ בֶּן־ שִׁמְרִ֔י וְיֹחָ֥א אָחִ֖יו הַתִּיצִֽי׃ס אֱלִיאֵל֙ הַֽמַּחֲוִ֔ים וִירִיבַ֥י וְיוֹשַׁוְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְנָ֑עַם וְיִתְמָ֖ה הַמּוֹאָבִֽי׃ אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְעוֹבֵ֔ד וְיַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל הַמְּצֹבָיָֽה׃פ
